title: A cell rect is turned into pixels at nine sites
body:
`((rect.column * font.cell_width) as i32, (rect.row * font.cell_height) as i32)` and the matching `columns`/`rows` size form appear at nine sites in `compositor.rs`: `pane_origin`, `client_geometry`, the ghost's `outer` and `offset` in `render`, the client loop in `render` twice, the picker thumbnails twice, and the grid in `render`. `Scene::px` in `draw.rs` does the same arithmetic but needs a `Scene`.

## Proposal

`Font::px_rect(&self, CellRect) -> Rectangle<i32, Physical>`, or a free function beside `CellRect`. The sites take `.loc` and `.size` from it. About 45 lines become about 12.
